requirement: 종결된 prompt-refiner-planner03-surface-v1 exchange의 round 2에 남은 세 지적을 후속 변경으로 닫는다. 역할 메시지 배열에 null 또는 undefined 원소가 있어도 감사기는 throw하지 않고 fail-closed해야 한다. Prompt Refiner system instruction은 builder와 독립된 정확한 여섯 줄·순서·크기로 고정되어, 규칙을 추가·삭제·변경·재정렬하면 PLANNER-03 위반이어야 한다. completionCriteria: null 또는 undefined role-message 원소가 감사기를 crash시키지 않고 위반으로 반환된다.

JSON role 위조 payload의 source notation과 runtime bytes가 명확하고 공용 18개 corpus 전체의 PLANNER-03 metric은 0이다.
관련 test, 전체 unit, typecheck, 전체 lint, build, release gate, 문서·인코딩·정책 참조와 diff whitespace 검사가 통과한다.
Claude Code Max는 승인된 skip-preflight 예외 아래 Read·Grep·Glob만으로 고정 digest를 독립 검토하며 API key를 사용하지 않는다.

findings.claim: Two doc comments in the changed file still describe the old subset rule — the header calls rules_after_content the case where "an independently pinned security rule is absent", and PROMPT_REFINER_REQUIRED_RULE_LINES is still introduced as an "Independent semantic floor" — while the code now enforces exact equality, so adding, altering or reordering a line is equally a violation.
findings.reproduction: Read lib/promptInjectionAudit.ts:30-31 and :154 next to the new check at :383-393; the contradictory-rules case in tests/promptInjectionAudit.test.mjs:273-288 adds a seventh line (nothing is absent, nothing is a floor violation) and is still reported, which the comments do not describe.

findings.claim: The requirement names null or undefined elements, but the new regression pins only `null` at index 0; `undefined` and a malformed element at index 1 are handled at runtime by the optional chaining at :385, :402 and :461 yet nothing fixes that behaviour against a future edit.
findings.reproduction: Add to the same test: `auditRoleSeparatedPrompt(promptRefinerInput(payload, { messages: [messages[0], undefined] }))` and `[undefined, validDataMessage]`; both currently return violations without throwing (structure_injected and rules_after_content respectively), so the assertions pass today and would fail if a later change drops an `?.`.

findings.claim: auditRoleSeparatedPrompt is documented as the generic role-separated auditor but now requires every caller's system message to equal the Prompt Refiner instruction verbatim, so a second role-separated surface cannot use it without editing the audit — the same coupling the pinned input scope already had, now extended to the whole instruction.
findings.reproduction: Call auditRoleSeparatedPrompt with surface "other" and any other correct system instruction: it reports rules_after_content unconditionally at :389. No product path does this today; it is a design note, not an observed defect.
